item.title: New paper: mapping public urban green spaces with open data
item.description: Our paper A reproducible geospatial workflow for detecting public urban green spaces using open data is out in City and Environment Interactions, with Pitchaporn Likitpanjamanon and Frank Ostermann. Read it (open access).

item.title: Workshop at FOSS4G 2026: GeoAI Level Up with QGIS
item.description: I ran the workshop GeoAI Level Up: Deep Learning and Spatial Data Preparation with QGIS at FOSS4G 2026. The workshop data is openly available on Zenodo.

item.title: ML4QGIS 0.4.0 released
item.description: Version 0.4.0 of ML4QGIS is out. Install it from the QGIS Plugin Manager, or see the code on GitHub.
